description:
Kaunas University of Technology is one of the most prominent universities of Lithuania and is in Kaunas. The university is home to more than 9,000 students and welcomes countless international students.

Kaunas University of Technology is a public research university offering a diverse choice of studies and collaborating with businesses. KTU has been one of the leading institutes of science education in Lithuania since its foundation in 1922. According to the 2021 Lithuanian National University Rankings, KTU was the second-best university in Lithuania. According to QS World University Rankings 2019, KTU is ranked among the top 500 global colleges based on employer reputation. Although Lithuanian is the major language of instruction, several courses are offered in both Lithuanian and English. Engineering, technology, physical and social sciences, humanities, and arts are all available at the university. Moreover, KTU research groups contribute to world scientific knowledge by undertaking cutting-edge multidisciplinary research on today's most important concerns.

KTU is one of the most open and flexible universities in Lithuania, maintaining significant relations with business and industry and participating in collaborative projects with major local enterprises, foreign organizations, and state and cultural institutions. International students can currently select from 37 undergraduate and postgraduate degree programs in English, as well as 19 doctoral programs in the fields of technological, physical, biomedical, and social sciences, humanities, and creative arts and design. The interplay of physical, social, and technical sciences, as well as humanities and arts, produces an open, interesting, and fruitful environment for the development of critical competencies today.

The University Library is one of the largest in Lithuania, housing and constantly replenishing one of the most extensive collections of printed books and journals on engineering, technology, and science in Lithuanian and other languages, as well as providing access to e-resources.

KTU not only established the first and most successful academic Startup Space, but it also contains the Baltics' largest science and technology park. Students have access to the most advanced research equipment available in Lithuania.
